compiled_state.title: S1.T3: Implement .github/workflows/review-sub-pr.yml additive workflow + GREEN T2's test
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: When this story is complete, `.github/workflows/review-sub-pr.yml` exists and triggers on PRs whose BASE branch matches `session/**`, `session-**`, `session_**`, or `bug-batch/**`

## Implementation Notes

Create `.github/workflows/review-sub-pr.yml`. Structure:

```yaml
name: review-sub-pr
on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - 'session/**'
      - 'session-**'
      - 'session_**'
      - 'bug-batch/**'
jobs:
  llm-review:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Compute diff and run reviewer
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN}
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY}
          PR_NUMBER: ${github.event.number}
        run: |
          gh pr diff "$PR_NUMBER" | bash plugins/dso/scripts/ci-llm-review-runner.sh
```

Key design notes:
- Use `branches:` filter on the PR BASE (confirmed by S1.T1 spike (i)).
- Reuse existing `ci-llm-review-runner.sh` — no new reviewer logic, just a new trigger surface.
- Permissions match `ci.yml:llm-review` (contents:read + pull-requests:write).
- This workflow is ADDITIVE per SC5(c) — does NOT modify ci.yml:llm-review's existing base_ref=='main' gating.

After implementation, T2's test must pass (GREEN). Remove the `[test_review_sub_pr_trigger]` RED marker from `.test-index`.

## File Impact

| Source file | Action | Associated tests | Test classification |
|-------------|--------|------------------|---------------------|
| `.github/workflows/review-sub-pr.yml` | create | `tests/workflows/test-review-sub-pr-trigger.sh` | needs-creation (RED test in T2) |
| `.test-index` | modify | n/a | n/a (remove RED marker) |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] `.github/workflows/review-sub-pr.yml` exists and is schema-valid
  Verify: test -f .github/workflows/review-sub-pr.yml && (command -v actionlint >/dev/null && actionlint .github/workflows/review-sub-pr.yml || python3 -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/review-sub-pr.yml'))")
- [ ] T2's RED test now passes (GREEN)
  Verify: bash tests/workflows/test-review-sub-pr-trigger.sh
- [ ] `.test-index` no longer carries `[test_review_sub_pr_trigger]` marker
  Verify: ! grep '\[test_review_sub_pr_trigger\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
